profiles_by_preset.master: Final-year Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering student at IOE, Kathmandu Engineering College, building applied ML systems, AI workflow tools, and embedded ML software. Fuse AI Fellow (Fusemachines) and NSSR DataCamp Fellow. I use AI to accelerate development, then turn recurring work into reusable tools and deterministic checks — reducing the need to solve the same task in another prompt. Experienced across demographic fairness auditing, multi-provider coordination, edge ML inference, and developer automation.
profiles_by_preset.research: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering undergraduate specializing in applied AI fairness auditing and empirical model evaluation. Fuse AI Fellow co-developing diagnostic prediction-auditing frameworks measuring canonical demographic parity and error-rate disparities across intersectional cohorts (AIF360, Fairlearn). Experienced in statistical evaluation, edge classifier validation on wearable sensor data, and reproducible benchmarking.
profiles_by_preset.systems: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering undergraduate building embedded ML software, firmware, and local systems utilities. ML and gateway lead for SPARK (ESP32-S3 wearable fall detection combining kinematic filtering with a quantized 18.5 KB INT8 CNN under FreeRTOS). Experienced in C/C++, TFLite Micro, microcontroller sensor interfacing, and native Windows systems utilities.
profiles_by_preset.aiml: Final-year engineering student and Fuse AI Fellow building applied machine learning pipelines, model-evaluation frameworks, and developer automation tools. Experienced in demographic performance auditing (AIF360, Fairlearn), tabular classification and explainability (XGBoost, SHAP), and containerized API services with FastAPI and Docker. Focuses on turning repetitive development steps into reliable tools and reproducible evaluation checks.
profiles_by_preset.fullstack: Final-year engineering student building AI workflow tooling, distributed agent coordination harnesses, and developer infrastructure. Developer of Fleet-Orchestrator (multi-step workflow coordination with provider adapters and task state inspection), Agent-Customization-Sync (cross-environment configuration and drift auditing), and custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.
profiles_by_preset.compact: Final-year Electronics & Information Engineering student at IOE Kathmandu Engineering College and Fuse AI Fellow. Builds applied ML systems, embedded AI (ESP32-S3 / TFLite Micro), and AI workflow tools. Uses AI to accelerate development and turns recurring workflows into reusable tools and deterministic checks.

fellowships.title: Fuse AI Fellow
fellowships.summary: Selected for competitive, intensive AI engineering fellowship covering ML, computer vision, NLP, and production MLOps.

bullets.text: Co-developed **BiasAperture**, an automated demographic fairness auditing pipeline measuring predictive disparities on computer vision benchmarks as the fellowship capstone project.
Built applied agentic and ML coursework pipelines including a 5-stage Text-to-SQL system (Planner → Generator → Validator → Executor → Summarizer) tested against structured evaluation suites.
Developed customer churn and lifetime value (CLV) prediction workflows utilizing **SMOTE**, cost-sensitive threshold tuning, and **SHAP** explainability.
Implemented MLOps coursework for experiment tracking, containerized microservices (**FastAPI**, **Docker**, **PostgreSQL**), and scheduled data-drift evaluation.
Evaluated probabilistic estimation and time-series forecasting ensembles on retail datasets as part of advanced predictive modeling modules.

fellowships.title: NSSR DataCamp Fellow (Cohort 2)
fellowships.summary: Awarded competitive sponsored fellowship for advanced data science and generative AI pathways.

bullets.text: Selected in competitive cohort for sponsored DataCamp access; developed applied GenAI workflows automating data cleaning, schema normalization, and exploratory analysis.
Completing advanced technical pathways in SQL database design, Python data analysis, and predictive modeling.

projects.title: BiasAperture — Computer Vision Demographic Fairness & Bias Audit
projects.subtitle: Fuse AI Fellowship Capstone Project
projects.summary: Diagnostic prediction-auditing framework measuring demographic parity and error-rate disparities across intersectional groups in computer vision.

bullets.text: Co-developed an automated prediction-auditing and reporting pipeline as a two-person fellowship capstone with Tisha Manandhar.
Audited classification performance across **126 demographic bins** on the FairFace benchmark (**97,698 images**), computing Disparate Impact Ratio, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equalized Odds.
Engineered self-contained HTML and PDF report generation with confidence intervals and diagnostic disparity plots; matched model comparison and validation remain active work.

projects.title: SPARK — Wearable Edge-AI Fall Detection System
projects.subtitle: Undergraduate Major Capstone Project
projects.summary: Embedded safety wearable combining kinematic acceleration thresholding with on-device neural confirmation on ESP32-S3.

bullets.text: Project lead for ML modeling, gateway processing, and explainability in a four-person team; hardware and firmware have dedicated owners.
Trained 1D-CNN fall-detection models on the SisFall benchmark (38 subjects, 38,420 windows), evaluating subject-stratified cross-validation with **0.9185 AUC-ROC** and 87.81% sensitivity.
Quantized model to an **18.5 KB INT8 CNN** footprint for ESP32-S3 edge deployment; on-device hardware testing, BLE streaming, and volunteer cohort validation remain pending.

projects.title: Fleet Orchestrator — AI Workflow Coordination & Tooling
projects.subtitle: AI Systems & Developer Infrastructure
projects.summary: Coordination tooling for multi-step AI workflows, managing task state, worker adapters, scheduling, and status inspection.

bullets.text: Built coordination tooling for multi-step AI workflows, with task state, worker adapters, scheduling, and live status inspection.
Standardized provider adapters (local models, CLI harnesses, API endpoints) with reusable interfaces to eliminate repeated orchestration scripts.
Integrated local MCP tool servers and automated execution logging to ensure reproducible batch processing and reliable error recovery.

projects.title: Agent-Customization-Sync — Cross-IDE Configuration Tooling
projects.subtitle: Developer Tooling & Configuration Governance
projects.summary: Cross-environment configuration synchronizer providing snapshotting, guarded restore, and drift auditing across IDEs.

bullets.text: Built configuration snapshots, guarded restore, rules transpilation, and SHA-256 drift audits across development environments (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code).
Audited instruction overhead and linked shared skills to reduce configuration duplication and maintain environment consistency across machines.

projects.title: Gesture-Controlled Self-Balancing Robot (GCSBR)
projects.subtitle: Undergraduate Minor Project

bullets.text: Implemented real-time PID stabilization firmware on an inverted pendulum robot, tuning balance control parameters for stable upright recovery.
Developed an Android companion app (Kotlin, MediaPipe Hands, CameraX) mapping hand gestures to directional actuation commands over Bluetooth.

projects.title: Super-NLM — Multi-Account NotebookLM Aggregator & MCP Tool

bullets.text: Developed an MCP tool server enabling AI agents to query notebooks, synchronize Google Drive research folders, and download Studio artifacts.
Implemented queue scheduling and quota-aware backoff handling to support automated document synthesis across study materials.

projects.title: Win-Vault — Native Windows Folder Privacy Utility
projects.subtitle: Systems Utility & Security
projects.summary: Lightweight Windows privacy utility locking directories via native NTFS Access Control Lists with zero third-party dependencies.

bullets.text: Engineered a zero-dependency Windows folder locking utility enforcing access restrictions via native NTFS Access Control Lists (ACLs).
Eliminated third-party driver overhead by utilizing standard operating system security permissions and PowerShell automation.

projects.title: NovaOptimizer / System-Optimizer — Workstation Memory Utility

bullets.text: Built a native Windows performance utility reclaiming **1.2–3.4 GB working-set RAM** under heavy multitasking developer workloads.
Automated background cleanup routines via standard Windows process memory APIs without disrupting active IDE sessions.

projects.title: nepali-ocr-ai — Low-Resource Document Processing Pipeline

Built preprocessing filters in OpenCV for uneven illumination and historical print noise reduction.
